subject: Novum Health CAIQ evidence gate & control matrix orchestration
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novumhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial CAIQ intake and evidence ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turn so far. As part of Novum Health's security intake for our platform evaluation, we need a CAIQ mapping that pairs Redwood's control descriptions to the CSA Cloud Controls Matrix, plus a short evidence bundle for the controls that affect tenant isolation, key management, and telemetry (specifically CCM_IAM, CCM_CRYPTO, CCM_LOG).

Can you share: 1) an owner-assigned control matrix (CSV/Excel) with which internal team owns each control, 2) a runnable evidence index with sample artifacts for the last 90 days (log snapshots, keystore rotation proof, RBAC screenshots), and 3) a point of contact for the audit team?

Target timeline: initial package by EOD next Tuesday (2027-04-13). Procurement has also asked for an estimated time-to-deliver and any DocuSign links for an NDA if needed.

Regards,
Elena Soto
Security Manager, Novum Health
Elena.Soto@novumhealth.com

Attachment: Novum_CAIQ_Ask_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Initial CAIQ intake and evidence ask

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can hit the EOD Tue window but want to scope the delivery to avoid over‑deliverable bulk. Proposed plan: 

- Day 1 (today): Share a control-owner matrix and CAIQ template populated with top-level assertions (CCM_IAM, CCM_CRYPTO, CCM_LOG prioritized).
- Day 2 (tomorrow): Provide an evidence index (zipped metadata + pointers) with 3 representative artifacts per control.
- Optional: Add a runtime replay package (if you want live telemetry playback, that will require a short access window).

Owners: Kimberly will shepherd telemetry/log extracts; Marissa will coordinate doc artifacts and legal attachments. I will be the customer contact for any clarifying technical Qs.

We are attaching a CAIQ template and a short evidence manifest example to accelerate. We anticipate the initial package will be uploaded to a shared drive link; if you prefer DocuSign for the NDA, send the procurement contact and we’ll route it.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: CAIQ_Request_Template.xlsx (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Initial CAIQ intake and evidence ask

Thanks — looping in the owners and quick ops notes.

Marissa and I split the work: I’ll produce the telemetry/log snapshots and a signed excerpt from our retention policy; Marissa will compile documentation (KMS rotation proof, access control screenshots, architecture narrative).

Action items: 
- Kimberly: deliver log snapshots + retention excerpt (samples in evidence_index.zip) — ETA EOD Tue.
- Marissa: compile CAIQ_Response_Draft.xlsx with control mappings and artifact pointers; I’ll review.
- Karthik: provide the final customer-facing summary and owner roster (name + role + contact).

We’ll upload the evidence_index.zip to the shared drive and post the link here when complete. Ship plan assumes Novum accepts redactions for tenant-identifying fields.

Date: 2027-04-12T15:38:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Initial CAIQ intake and evidence ask

Karthik / Kimberly / Marissa — this looks good, thank you. Procurement contact is listed below (CC’d). We will accept redacted artifacts for now; audit will request live sessions if necessary. DocuSign for the NDA is preferable — procurement, can you initiate?

Procurement has also asked that the owner roster include escalation contacts for support (pager or oncall email). If you can add that to the final owner sheet, great.

We will review the upload when you post it and follow up with any clarifying questions by Friday.

Thanks,
Elena

Procurement POC: Michael Lang <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Audit addr: audit@novumhealth.com
